title: Poop at a Concert? This Singer Has a Funny Request
summary:
Imagine you’re at a concert, dancing and singing, when suddenly—ewww!—you smell something terrible. That’s what happened at Noah Kahan’s show in Philadelphia on Friday night. Someone left poop on the floor near the seats! A video of the mess went viral, and people couldn’t stop talking about it.

Noah Kahan, the singer, had the funniest reaction. He wrote on X (formerly Twitter): “If you have to poop at a show please dear god just go to the bathroom.” He even joked that he’s pooped his pants “as much as the next 29 year old”—but then said he once did it on stage because he’s “dedicated to my craft” (that means he’s super serious about his music).

A fan named Turd Furguson (yes, really!) replied that a 29-year-old should have zero pants-pooping stories. Noah fired back, “Okay Turd Ferguson,” keeping the whole thing light and silly.

But behind the jokes, Noah reminded everyone to think about the workers at the venue. He said one worker had a “1000 yard stare”—a look of total shock after cleaning up the mess. So next time you’re at a show and nature calls, do everyone a favor: find the bathroom! Noah’s tour continues, and he’s hoping fans in Toronto will take his advice.
why_it_matters: Even at a fun event like a concert, being considerate of the people who work there makes the experience better for everyone.

background_read: Noah Kahan (an American singer-songwriter famous for songs like 'Stick Season') often jokes around with fans online.
At big concerts, the venue staff work hard to keep the place clean and safe, but sometimes unexpected messes happen.
Social media can turn a small, silly moment into a huge talking point that everyone discusses for days.
Article_Structure: WHO: Noah Kahan, a fan who left poop on the floor, and a fan username Turd Furguson.
WHAT: A messy incident at a concert that became a funny online exchange and a reminder to use bathrooms.
WHERE: At Noah Kahan's show in Philadelphia, and online on X (Twitter).
WHY: Because someone didn't use the bathroom and the worker who cleaned up was left in shock, so Noah joked about it and asked fans to be more considerate.

perspectives.description: By joking about the mess, Noah turned a gross moment into something silly that made people laugh. He also reminded fans to care about the venue workers.
Leaving poop on the floor was thoughtless and showed no respect for the cleaners whose job it is to keep the place safe. The worker's shocked look showed how upsetting it was.
The whole story shows how quickly a weird event can spread online and get everyone talking, turning a quiet worker's bad night into a widely known joke.
